title: Page Hub adoption declaration
description: An explicit declaration of the Publications Page Hub should adopt. Page Hub never infers Publication boundaries from storage; every proposed Project prefix, Publication path, object key, entry point, and routing mode is named here. Adopting never writes, copies, or deletes storage objects.

prefix.description: Single top-level path segment owned by the Project. Must not be the reserved '_page-hub'.

displayName.description: Optional human display name; defaults to the publication path's last segment.

path.description: Exact publication path: the project prefix itself (Root Publication) or a path beneath it. Trailing slashes and '.', '..' segments are rejected.

displayName.description: Optional human display name; defaults to the publication path's last segment.

entryPoint.description: Exact object key used as the entry point. Must be part of the declared object set. Character case is preserved exactly.

routingMode.description: exact_file serves one object at the publication path; directory_index serves the entry point for the publication path and subpaths; fallback serves the entry point for any unmatched subpath.

items.description: Exact bucket object key: the publication path itself (exact-file Publications) or the publication path plus a relative suffix.
